primary.title: BLS Polymers shares hit record high! Up 106% from IPO price, recently-listed multibagger stock soars 8% today | Buy?
primary.summary: BLS Polymers reported strong Q2FY27 results, with revenue up 28.92% year on year to ₹125.56 crore and profit after tax rising 130.63% to ₹10.54 crore. Shares climbed to a record high after already gaining about 103% from the IPO price.
